note: Reviewed starter answers for Plzeň NPC missions (server/npc/lore.mjs). Well-known public places only; no opening hours or prices, which change. Players add to this through NPC missions.

entries.text: Na Spilce, the big beer hall inside the Pilsner Urquell brewery, serves the beer a few steps from where it is brewed.
U Salzmannů on Pražská street is one of the oldest pubs in town, with a classic Czech beer hall feel.
Na Parkánu next to the Brewery Museum is known for unfiltered Pilsner and a quiet courtyard garden.
Purkmistr in Černice is a small brewery with its own beers, a short ride from the centre.
For Czech classics like svíčková or goulash, explorers like the brewery restaurant Na Spilce.
Around Republic Square there are many cafés and bistros for a quick bite between quests.
Na Parkánu serves hearty Czech pub food that goes well with its unfiltered beer.
St. Bartholomew Cathedral on Republic Square has the tallest church tower in the country, with a gallery open to visitors.
The Great Synagogue is one of the largest synagogues in the world, with twin towers and a striking hall.
The Pilsner Urquell brewery gate and tour show where the first golden lager was brewed in 1842.
Techmania Science Center is a hands-on science museum, good on a rainy day.
The Patton Memorial museum tells how the city was liberated in 1945.
The Puppet Museum on Republic Square celebrates the famous local puppets Spejbl and Hurvínek.
Under the old town runs a maze of old cellars and passages; the Historical Underground tour lets you walk part of it.
On the cathedral's north side a small angel sits on the iron grille; locals touch it for luck and a wish.
The Franciscan monastery hides the painted Chapel of St. Barbara, a quiet gem right in the centre.
The Renaissance water tower on Pražská street is a piece of old Plzeň that many visitors walk past without a second look.
The best view of the whole town is from the gallery of St. Bartholomew's tower, open to visitors.
The riverside paths along the Radbuza give an easy walk with views back to the cathedral tower.
